title: Crunchyroll’s Major Action Fantasy Unveils New Trailer Ahead of Major Arc
content: One of the biggest action fantasy series, Wistoria: Wand and Sword , released its highly anticipated second season as part of the Spring 2026 lineup. The anime, based on a light novel series by Fujino Omori, debuted in 2024 and became a major hit, praised for its animation, worldbuilding, and characters.
author: ComicBook

title: After 16 Years, Family Guy Finally Reveals a New Star Wars Crossover – See The First Footage
content: It’s been 16 years since Family Guy took on Star Wars , and now they have dropped a new crossover after all this time. Family Guy ‘s trilogy of Star Wars parody specials are some of the highest regarded episodes of the series overall.
author: ComicBook

title: 10/10 Sci-Fi Classic Reveals Reboot Anime Release Date With New Trailer
content: A 10/10 science fiction anime classic is coming back for a new anime reboot later this Summer, and the new series has confirmed its release date with a cool new trailer and poster showing it off.

title: My Friend's Little Sister Has it in For Me Manga Ends in Next Volume This Fall
content: The 11th volume of Hira Hiraoka 's manga adaptation of Ghost Mikawa 's My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me! ( Tomodachi no Imōto ga Ore ni Dake Uzai ) light novel series revealed on Thursday the manga will end in the 12th volume in early fall.
author: ANN

title: Chronicles of the Going Home Club's Kuroha Launches New Manga
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ website launched manga creator Kuroha 's new manga titled SATANICA on May 9. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service releases the manga's simulpub and describes the story: Machino and her friends are hard at work on their occult research again today.
author: ANN

title: After 15 Years, Bob’s Burgers Is Breaking a Fox Tradition With Major Change
content: 15 years after it made its debut with Fox, Bob’s Burgers is breaking a major tradition with a schedule change that’s going to impact its future. title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Casts Knights Moralis
content: The staff for the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga announced four more cast members for the Knights Moralis on Monday: Jun Kasama as Utowin Hiroki Yasumoto as Galga Yui Ishikawa as Luluci The four character will start appearing in the anime in the seventh and eighth episodes on May 18…

title: Moka Onmae's 'Good Morning, Good Night, and See You Tomorrow.' Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga and will release the first volume in November. Seven Seas describes the story: When it comes to the topic of cancer, there is no one way to handle the news. For one young woman, Akiyama Momiji, the diagnosis leads her to reevaluate her life.

title: 5 Years Later, Major Crunchyroll Anime Suddenly Removed From Streaming With No Season 2 Hopes
content: Five years after it made its original debut, one major sci-fi anime has suddenly been removed from Crunchyroll (and slated to leave other streaming platforms) with no hopes of a second season.

title: The Killer Angel Within: Ameku Takao's Detective Karte Manga to End in 3rd Volume
content: The manga, based on Chinen's Ameku Takao's Detective Karte light novel series, launched in Good! Afternoon in September 2024. Kodansha published the manga's first and second volumes in January and August 2025, respectively.
author: ANN
